cooccurrence_snapshot.method: exact co-occurrence of approved claim-feature tags across five finance projections
cooccurrence_snapshot.limitation: Feature tags are bounded to approved projections; zero co-occurrence is corpus rarity only and is not evidence of global novelty or usefulness.

extracted_facts.claim: Fin-JEPA predicts ten future 64-dimensional latents from a thirty-step daily context and uses SIGReg against collapse.
Latent prediction improves over identity, while prediction error does not reliably discriminate forward returns.
CET combines price-volume and earnings contexts and contrastively predicts future price-volume latents.
CET targets event-time next-minute movement because earnings information decays after release.
The FX Transformer uses multivariate cross-asset technical and fundamental inputs for ten-minute return prediction.
The study compares Transformer, LSTM, and ARIMA across three FX spot rates using financial and statistical metrics.
EXFormer uses multiscale trends, dynamic exogenous-variable selection, and regime-sensitive attention for daily FX returns.
EXFormer forecasts day-ahead FX returns using multiscale receptive fields and 28 dynamically weighted exogenous covariates.
A denoising autoencoder reconstructs smoother series, recomputes labels, and improves downstream classification on daily and high-frequency data.
The study evaluates denoised labels with an SVM and binary trading strategies on daily S&P 500, one-minute Bitcoin, and limit-order data.

inferred_gaps.title: Representation fidelity is not aligned with economic utility
inferred_gaps.inference: The corpus lacks a validated link from improved latent prediction to calibrated, actionable return or risk decisions.
inferred_gaps.uncertainty: This is a gap in the five-paper approved corpus, not proof that the broader literature lacks such a link.

inferred_gaps.title: Event and regime conditioning are separated from latent prediction
inferred_gaps.inference: No approved paper jointly trains a JEPA latent predictor across event-time, regime, and multiple forecast horizons.
inferred_gaps.uncertainty: General time-series JEPA and financial regime models partially overlap this direction outside the approved corpus.

inferred_gaps.title: Cross-asset, earnings, and exogenous context are not integrated into a financial JEPA objective
inferred_gaps.inference: The approved corpus separates JEPA latent prediction from event, cross-asset, and dynamically selected exogenous context.
inferred_gaps.uncertainty: External multimodal finance models cover much of the context machinery without using JEPA.

inferred_gaps.title: Target construction and evaluation protocols are not comparable
inferred_gaps.inference: Latent MSE, movement classification, return forecasts, trading metrics, and denoised labels are evaluated under incompatible targets and horizons.
inferred_gaps.uncertainty: A larger corpus may reveal an existing normalization benchmark; none is present in the approved set.

proposed_ideas.title: Calibrated latent-distribution Fin-JEPA for regime-specific abstention

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

proposed_ideas.mechanistic_bridge: Replace point latent prediction with a calibrated latent distribution and use context-only regime strata to test whether uncertainty supports abstention. Regime detection and multi-horizon prediction are controls inherited from Fin-JEPA future work; the distinct hypothesis is calibrated distributional uncertainty tied to risk-coverage.
proposed_ideas.distinct_from_source_future_work: Fin-JEPA proposes PELT regimes and multi-horizon training but does not propose or evaluate calibrated latent distributions, abstention, or risk-coverage.

falsifiable_test.design: Walk-forward equity and FX evaluation with regime labels fit inside each training fold; compare point JEPA, the paper's regime and multi-horizon future-work baseline, distributional JEPA, and calibrated abstention.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: out-of-sample latent negative log likelihood with calibration error
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if calibration or risk-coverage does not improve over point Fin-JEPA in held-out regimes.

proposed_ideas.title: Event-conditioned financial JEPA with causal relevance gating

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

proposed_ideas.mechanistic_bridge: Encode timestamp-safe earnings and dynamically selected exogenous context separately, open a relevance gate only when that context adds predictive information beyond price history, and train the gated context to predict future market latents across event-time windows. The causal relevance gate is imported from external GS-FUSE/CAMEF prior art and is not an approved-corpus fact.

falsifiable_test.design: Pre-register earnings and exogenous-data availability timestamps; compare price-only JEPA, unconditional fusion, relevance-gated fusion, and shuffled-event controls with purged walk-forward folds.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: event-window future-latent prediction gain over price-only JEPA
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if gains disappear against shuffled events or if the gate uses information unavailable at decision time.

proposed_ideas.title: Dual-target Fin-JEPA for raw dynamics and denoised market state

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

proposed_ideas.mechanistic_bridge: Train one predictor against the ordinary future encoder latent and a second head against a denoised, volatility-aware state target, forcing shared context features to preserve fast dynamics while exposing a smoother decision-relevant state.

falsifiable_test.design: Compare raw-target JEPA, denoised-target-only JEPA, dual-target JEPA, and shuffled-denoising controls on equities, Bitcoin, and FX with identical walk-forward splits.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: held-out downstream state classification at matched latent prediction error
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if denoised targets improve labels but not held-out economic metrics, or if raw-latent fidelity materially degrades.

candidate_axis_hypothesis.definition: The primary level at which a representation is validated: representation fidelity, predictive task, economic utility, or calibrated risk.
candidate_axis_hypothesis.measurement_protocol: Two reviewers independently assign one primary validation target from the paper's declared primary metric; disagreements are adjudicated and multi-target studies retain a secondary tag.
candidate_axis_hypothesis.residual_value: Distinguishes whether a method stops at latent fidelity or validates decision/risk utility, which current mechanism/target/horizon axes do not encode directly.
